properties.aiTake: A genuine self-build opportunity with planning already granted, in Exmouth itself, at a rock-bottom price — but you'd be building from scratch on top of the purchase cost, and the auction date needs confirming directly with the agent since the one found online looks stale.

parking.note: Undeveloped plot — no existing parking. Any parking would need to be designed into the self-build; the listing doesn't give plot dimensions or road frontage detail to judge feasibility.

properties.title: Fore Street Hill, Budleigh Salterton (split-level flat)
properties.body: A one-bedroom flat in Budleigh Salterton, arranged over two floors — spacious living/dining room and fitted kitchen on the ground floor, bedroom and bathroom on the first. Double glazing and gas central heating throughout. Two allocated parking spaces, close to shops, supermarkets, restaurants and pubs. Chain-free, vacant and ready for immediate possession. Leasehold with 121 years remaining. Council Tax Band A.
properties.why: Family-submitted find via the site's submission form. It's the cheapest thing on the whole list bar the auction flats, chain-free, and comes with two allocated parking spaces — genuinely unusual for a flat at this price. The catch is it isn't ground-floor (bedroom and bathroom are upstairs), so it doesn't quite fit the usual flat rule, and there's no garden or particular character beyond being in Budleigh itself. Worth a look as a cheap, practical fallback rather than a dream find.
properties.aiTake: Rock-bottom price, chain-free, and a rare two allocated parking spaces, but it's split over two floors rather than true ground-floor and has no character or garden to speak of — a cheap fallback, not a contender.

properties.title: Fore Street, Otterton (Grade II thatched cottage)
properties.body: A semi-detached Grade II listed thatched cottage in the centre of Otterton village, backing onto farmland. Inglenook fireplace with an original bread oven, leaded light windows, exposed timbers, and a vaulted kitchen with garden views. Extensive rear gardens with a raised pond and fruit trees. Private driveway with space for two cars. No mains gas; electricity, water and drainage connected. Freehold, Council Tax Band E. Guide price reduced from an earlier figure on 30/03/2026.
properties.why: This is exactly the thatched-cottage archetype Jesse loves, and it's genuinely in Otterton itself — about as close to a brother as it gets. It's a third over the £300k ceiling, but the search brief explicitly calls out cute thatched cottages as worth including over budget when they're this good a match, so it's here flagged clearly rather than dropped. Real driveway parking for two cars is a bonus most thatched finds on this list don't have.

properties.aiTake: The thatched-cottage archetype Jesse loves, right in Otterton next to a brother, with real driveway parking — but £400k is a third over budget, which is the only thing holding this back from a top score.

parking.note: Private driveway with space for two cars — confirmed directly in the listing.

properties.title: Longbrook Lane, Lympstone (renovated cottage)
properties.body: A period terraced cottage on Longbrook Lane in Lympstone (a different property from the fixer-upper already tracked on the same lane), with a 22-foot sitting/dining room with bay window and fireplace, a compact kitchen, two double bedrooms with sash windows, and attic access. Low-maintenance rear courtyard with gravel and paving. Freehold. Guide price reduced on 12/06/2026.
properties.why: A second, more finished cottage on the same Lympstone lane as an existing fixer-upper find — same great village location (estuary, own station, Woodbury Common close), but this one is move-in ready rather than needing full modernisation, for £30k more. On-street parking only, and a courtyard rather than a garden.
properties.aiTake: Move-in ready and in the best-located village on the list, with real period character (bay window, fireplace, sash windows), but on-street parking only and a courtyard instead of a garden.

properties.title: Globe Hill, Woodbury (Fairview Cottages)
properties.body: A well-presented two-bedroom semi-detached period cottage (2 Fairview Cottages) on Globe Hill, on the edge of Woodbury village. Exposed timbers, stripped floorboards, and a woodburner in the sitting room; main bedroom has countryside views. Rear cottage-style garden (23' x 13') with patio, raised beds, a small shed, and side gate access. Freehold, Council Tax Band B, EPC E. Price reduced 06/05/2026.
properties.why: A cheap, genuinely characterful Woodbury cottage — close to a brother and Woodbury Common's trails, same as the other Woodbury cottages already tracked. Zoopla's anti-scraping blocked most of the photo gallery (only one image recovered), and parking isn't mentioned either way, so both are worth checking directly with the agent before getting excited.
properties.aiTake: A cheap, characterful Woodbury cottage with a real garden and close to a brother — held back only by unconfirmed parking and a thin photo set (Zoopla blocked most of the gallery).

properties.body: A semi-detached period cottage ("Stedifords") on Broadway, Woodbury, blending character with modern living: living room with fireplace, newly fitted open-plan kitchen, two bedrooms, a walk-in wardrobe, and a contemporary shower room. Enclosed front garden with gravel patio and flower beds; enclosed rear courtyard garden with side access. Freehold, chain-free, Council Tax Band B, EPC D. Roughly equidistant between Exeter and Exmouth. Price reduced 06/05/2026.
properties.why: Another cheap, chain-free Woodbury cottage, recently updated rather than needing work — a good practical option close to a brother and the Common. As with the other Zoopla find today, the gallery was mostly blocked (one image recovered) and parking isn't stated, both worth chasing with the agent.
properties.aiTake: Cheap, chain-free, and already updated rather than needing work, close to a brother and the Common — but unconfirmed parking and a near-empty photo set (Zoopla blocked the gallery) keep it from scoring higher.

research.question: Look further into what you actually do for parking on The Strand, Lympstone.
research.findings: The Strand itself has no dedicated resident bays — parking there is on-street with no confirmed residents' zone. Two car parks serve the immediate area: the free Lympstone Village Station car park right on The Strand (13 spaces, no permit needed, first-come-first-served, but can fill up with rail commuters), and Underhill Car Park a short walk away. Underhill's management has been unsettled for a while — East Devon District Council was in talks with Lympstone Parish Council years ago about the Parish taking it over and potentially issuing permits, and I couldn't confirm what, if anything, was finalised or whether a strict residents' scheme runs there now. Beyond that, East Devon District Council sells modular monthly/annual town permits for its pay-and-display car parks generally, but I couldn't confirm Lympstone is one of the towns those permits cover, nor find a price. Devon County Council handles on-street residents' permit zones separately and I couldn't confirm one exists for The Strand either. Bottom line: there's workable free/cheap parking nearby (the station car park is the best bet), but nothing deeded to the property and nothing guaranteed — worth a direct call to Lympstone Parish Council or East Devon's parking team before relying on it.

properties.title: Woodbury (Grade II Listed one-bed cottage)
properties.body: A one-bedroom Grade II Listed cottage in Woodbury village, with exposed ceiling beams and a feature fireplace in the sitting room, a separate study, recently-fitted kitchen, and a ground-floor bathroom. Upstairs is a single double bedroom with a walk-in wardrobe. Enclosed rear garden with patio and decking. Freehold. Marketed by East of Exe, Topsham.
properties.why: Cheap, genuinely characterful, freehold, and right in Woodbury near Bro 2 and Woodbury Common's trails — the trade-off is that it's a small one-bed with no off-street parking, so it suits a single-person or downsizer scenario more than a family home.
properties.aiTake: A cheap, genuinely characterful Grade II cottage right in Woodbury near Bro 2 — but it's a tiny one-bed with no off-street parking, so it trades space and convenience for charm and price.

parking.note: On-street parking only, but Woodbury village has a small free short-stay car park (Flower Street) within a couple of minutes' walk, same as noted for the Mirey Lane cottage already tracked — a realistic fallback if the street itself is full.

properties.title: Cliff Road, Budleigh Salterton (ground-floor flat, sea views)
properties.body: A genuinely ground-floor, two-double-bedroom apartment in a small modern block (12 units) on Cliff Road, Budleigh Salterton, with a south-facing terrace looking over the communal garden towards the sea. Open-plan sitting room with sea views and patio access, fitted kitchen with appliances, separate WC plus a modern bathroom. One allocated parking space, with additional visitor parking. Direct access to the coastal footpath via the communal gardens. Share of freehold, 999-year lease from 1982 (roughly 955 years remaining), service charge £200/month. Chain-free. EPC C, very low flood risk.
properties.why: Clears the flats bar cleanly — genuinely ground-floor, cheap, chain-free, and with real allocated parking, which is unusual for a sub-£250k flat here. The sea view and direct coastal footpath access from a shared garden are a real plus for a flat at this price. It's a modern block rather than anything characterful, and the communal garden isn't private, but the near-999-year lease means it behaves like freehold in practice. A solid, low-drama fallback rather than a dream find.

checklist.uniqueFeature: South-facing terrace with a sea view plus direct access to the coastal footpath via the communal gardens

properties.aiTake: A genuinely ground-floor, sea-view flat with real allocated parking and a near-freehold-length lease — practical and cheap, if short on character.

parking.note: One allocated parking space included, plus additional visitor parking on site — confirmed in the listing.
